 │   keeps the split rects even when the tab is zoomed, so the bridge still sees 60 cols; (2) with a TUI attached, zoom
 │   resizes only the focused pane's PTY, but with no client attached it resizes nothing; (3) zoom is per tab, shared
 │   with your own herdr TUI, and is cleared by any split or sibling close, and moves with focus. Which design do you
 │   want?
   → Auto-zoom + zoom-aware size (Recommended)
